sentence: One hedged IC lot risks 91,029 CNY a year = 113.8% of the 8% budget on 1,000,000, the same risk as 86.6% of the ETF book. Per yuan it needs (1,137,862), the lot returns 9.59% against 8.00% risk (Sharpe 1.20) while the ETF book returns 10.89% against 10.51% (Sharpe 1.08). That rung is 1.14x this capital, so the swap is not buyable today.
caveats: Ruler A reads the sizing face's own hedged-vol figure; ruler C multiplies the risk face's ann_vol by the same notional. They differ by -17.7% on IC (different windows) and are printed side by side, never averaged.
The ETF book's vol is its measured 8%-target implementation (it de-levers only), not the 8% target itself.
Replacing the ETF core also removes its bond/cash defensive leg; this face prices risk and return, not the drawdown path in a crash.
One lot is a discrete jump: there is no partial lot below the first rung.
